root_cause: The openvino_tokenizers wheel build vendors the pcre2 library source via CMake FetchContent, downloading pcre2-10.48.zip directly from github.com release assets at configure time. On this run's first attempt, github.com's release-asset CDN returned an HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout for that single GET request, causing FetchContent_Populate to abort and the pip wheel build to fail with a metadata-generation error. The identical job succeeded outright on the automatic second attempt (run_attempt=2) with no code or workflow changes, confirming a transient upstream GitHub CDN blip rather than a PR-induced regression; the PR's changes are entirely in src/plugins/intel_cpu (JIT ISA selection) and unrelated to the tokenizers build.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reliably reproducible locally; requires hitting a transient HTTP 504 from github.com's release CDN while CMake FetchContent downloads https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/releases/download/pcre2-10.48/pcre2-10.48.zip during the openvino_tokenizers wheel build (job 'OpenVINO tokenizers extension').
recommended_actions: No PR-side action needed: rerun the failed job or re-add the PR to the merge queue (already succeeded on retry, run_attempt=2).
Consider vendoring/mirroring pcre2-10.48.zip in an internal artifact cache or GitHub Packages to avoid depending on github.com release-asset availability during CI builds.

Add a CMake FetchContent retry/backoff (e.g., FETCHCONTENT_TIMEOUT / multiple URLs) for the pcre2-populate download step in openvino_tokenizers/src/CMakeLists.txt to reduce sensitivity to single transient CDN errors.
prevention_strategies: Mirror third-party source archives fetched via CMake FetchContent (e.g., pcre2) to a controlled, higher-availability location (GitHub Packages, internal artifactory) instead of pulling directly from github.com release assets at build time; add retry logic around FetchContent downloads in CI-critical build paths.
historical_context: Similar but distinct GitHub-CDN HTTP error patterns have recurred multiple times: node-api-headers HTTP 502 (pattern 204f6134e10bd5d3, 1 occurrence), oneapi-tbb CMake download HTTP error (pattern 2a69e2049aca6b9b, 1 occurrence), and EasyOCR HTTP 504 Gateway Time-out during PyTorch Models tests (pattern 9cb03e077ef3024a, 2 occurrences). This is the first recorded occurrence of the pcre2-10.48.zip download failing specifically; it is tracked as a new pattern (2baab38e090720ec) rather than merged with the above since the source URL/package differs.
